standard_prerequisites.name: Tournament inversion number, symmetric matrix minimum rank and finite-field matrix counting
standard_prerequisites.statement: Original inversion operation, directed join, matrix-to-tournament map, minimum-rank comparison and cited symmetric-rank counting bounds retained.
standard_prerequisites.use: The complete quantitative TheoremT2 proof is explicitly bundled into the counted inversion-number theoremT1; T2 and the further sufficiently-large-value theorem are not separate counts.

core_obligations: Constructs paired symmetric matrices linked by an invertible congruence map, proves a low-rank dijoin block construction, and combines symmetric-matrix enumeration with a union bound to make both individual tournament minimum ranks nearly n while the dijoin rank is at most n. Transfers the quantitative rank construction to inversion number to obtain an asymptotic one-half ratio.
